title: Connect 4
subtitle: Strategy & Precision
instruction: Use keys 1-7 to drop pieces. Strategy is the key to victory.
funModeUnavailable: Fun modes are available in PVP and serverless online only.
randomPowerDescription: Resolve a fresh random power when a new game starts.
doubleDropDescription: Take two legal drops in the same turn.
columnLockDescription: Block one column for your opponent's next turn.
colorFlipDescription: Turn an adjacent enemy disc into your color.
airDropDescription: Place one disc in any supported empty cell.
clearTopDescription: Remove the topmost disc from a column.
shieldDescription: Protect one of your discs from one clear effect.
popOutHint: Click a bottom handle under a column with your own disc.
classicRule: Classic Connect 4: drop one disc per turn and connect four in any direction.
popoutRule: Drop normally or pop one of your own bottom discs out of a column.
gravityRule: Gravity changes direction every four turns; pieces slide in from the opposite side.
bombRule: Each player has two bombs that clear nearby discs after landing.
wildColumnRule: Five scattered occupied wild spots can count for either player in a line.
powerupRule: Each player gets one special power, random by default. Pick from Double Drop, Column Lock, Swap Pair, Color Flip, Air Drop, Clear Top, Shield, or Extra Bomb.
risingFloorRule: Every five turns, the bottom row disappears and the board drops down.
connect5Rule: Connect five instead of four. Each turn gives you two drops unless the first one wins.
historyInstruction: Click a move to jump back
failedToCreateGame: Failed to create game. Database might not be configured.
seoSectionIntro: A completely free online Connect 4 game with smooth gameplay, fun modes, power-ups, and instant matches.
seoQa1Question: Can I play this game for free?
seoQa1Answer: Yes. The game is fully free to play in your browser.
seoQa2Question: Do I need to create an account?
seoQa2Answer: No. You can play instantly without signup or login.
seoQa3Answer: No. There are no ads and no paywalls.
seoQa4Question: Can I play with friends online?
seoQa4Answer: Yes. Create an online game and share the code or link.
